description: This file defines the 'WorkShift' entity class for the OrangeHRM application, representing work shift data including id, name, hours per day, start time, and end time, with ORM mappings and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: WorkShift
classes.description: Entity class representing a work shift with properties for id, name, hours per day, start time, and end time, using Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.
